cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark is successfully added into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Delete Bookmark Properly
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark is properly deleted from the bookmarks file and no longer displayed from all access points.

cases.title: Add bookmark to personal toolbar
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark is successfully added to the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Delete bookmark from personal toolbar
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark is successfully deleted from the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Insert new bookmark folder into the bookmarks hierarchy
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark folder is successfully inserted into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Launch Bookmark in Browser Window
cases.description: Verify that double-clicking on a bookmark causes it to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Validate links in default bookmarks file
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks within the default bookmarks file that is packaged with the browser are valid links.

cases.title: Verify saving changes to a bookmark item without loss of item integrity
cases.description: Modify a bookmark item and ensure that the changes are saved correctly without any loss of item integrity.

cases.title: Delete Bookmarks Folder
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks folder is successfully deleted.

cases.title: Add bookmarks separator
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks separator can be successfully added.

cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks separator can be successfully deleted.

cases.title: Verify bookmark changes persist over browser restart
cases.description: Perform changes to bookmarks, restart the browser, and verify that the bookmark changes are successfully saved and retained.

cases.title: View properties execution for bookmarks, folders, and separators
cases.description: Verify that view properties execute for bookmarks, folders, and separators negatively as specified in requirement R-011.

cases.title: Rename bookmark inline without properties dialog
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be renamed directly inline within the view without having to use the bookmarks properties dialog.

cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be successfully found using a user-defined custom keyword.

cases.title: Sort bookmarks per column
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks are sorted per column.

cases.title: Reverse-sort bookmarks per column
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks are reverse-sorted per column.

cases.title: Resize Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be resized to show or hide more of the entries.

cases.title: Show and Hide Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be successfully showed and hidden.

cases.title: Delete multiple bookmarks at one time
cases.description: Verify that several bookmarks can be deleted simultaneously from the bookmarks collection.

cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto itself.

cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto its immediate parent.

cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark onto its immediate child
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto its immediate child.

coverage.feedback: The accepted cases provide comprehensive and direct coverage of all 18 requirements (R-001 through R-018) without any noticeable excess, repetition, or overgeneration. Each test case maps precisely to its respective requirement, including split coverage for multi-part requirements like adding/deleting from the personal toolbar (R-003), adding/deleting separators (R-009), sorting/reverse-sorting (R-014), and preventing drops onto itself, parent, or child (R-018). There are no coverage gaps or ungrounded speculative behaviors present in the test set.
